Freight Shipping vs Moving Company

How to choose between freight shipping and a moving company.

Author: Ralph Ivey

Last updated: 2026-07-20

Experience: Written for working trucking and moving businesses.

Answer

Choose based on flexibility, handling, inventory type, insurance, and whether the job is household or freight-focused.
